phase: L5.1 Human Validation Cognitive Load Review
status: DESIGN-ONLY / READ-ONLY (no implementation, no experiment, no frozen artifact/schema/code modification)
research_question: RQ-L5.1: Can DICE reduce long-term Human Validation cognitive burden via Evidence Aggregation + Evidence Compression, without transferring abstraction work from System to Human?
core_design_principles_fixed: DICE Pattern should compress evidence for humans, not transfer abstraction work to humans
Any design requiring Human to find commonality/compare instances/build negative set/discover boundary/construct pattern = potential Human Abstraction Burden, not default-reasonable

A_instance_validation.description: Observation N -> Human judgment per instance

B_naive_pattern_validation.description: Many instances -> Pattern candidate -> Human reads prototype+boundary+negative+UNKNOWN+provenance+scope -> Human understands pattern -> validates

C_minimal_semantic_validation.description: System aggregation+comparison+compression -> Pattern candidate -> Minimal Semantic Claim -> Human answers SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN

system_vs_human_responsibility.current_gap: System aggregation/compression capability ABSENT (L5 review grep 0; no schema/object/process for reusable pattern) [O]

cognitive_load_model.hvc_expression: HVC = a*review_count + b*evidence_exposure + g*cross_instance_comparison + d*abstraction_burden + e*interaction_cost + z*decision_complexity + h*error_risk + q*fatigue

workflow_B.key_finding: evidence_exposure 30-60 > A's 21 = direct evidence of burden transfer [I]

simulation_21_cases.comparison_verdict: B not better than A (exposure higher); C optimal by design but depends on unimplemented System capability + unverified burden-transfer mitigation [I]

counterexample_1.claim: Pattern reduces 90% count but each 10x complex
counterexample_1.evidence: B exposure 30-60 > A 21 = burden transfer not reduction [I]
counterexample_1.reason: C default exposure 3-4 < A; abstraction=0; BUT requires trustworthy System

counterexample_2.claim: System forms pattern but Human must verify System formed it correctly
counterexample_2.residual_risk: silent evidence suppression undetectable at summary level -> needs audit mechanism

burden_transfer_redteam.record: Workflow B = BURDEN TRANSFER; Workflow C = BURDEN REDUCTION by design IF trustworthy + honest + on-demand-auditable; unverified

progressive_disclosure.level_1_evidence_summary: instance count / consistency / conflicts / UNKNOWN / coverage
progressive_disclosure.level_3_boundary_negative_unknown: boundary conditions / negative set / UNKNOWN cases
progressive_disclosure.risk: hiding important evidence if summary dishonest
progressive_disclosure.mitigation_principle: Evidence visibility != Evidence authority (not-shown != not-existent; all levels reachable on-demand; summary must be honest; provenance auditable)
progressive_disclosure.residual_risk: Human never drills down -> depends on summary honesty -> needs audit mechanism (future)

10_cases.C: simple but System overhead may not pay off

model_2.definition: Pattern organizes evidence; Human validates semantic claim (pattern=evidence-org/reuse layer, transparent to Human)
counterarguments_addressed: Human need not understand pattern internals to judge claim-vs-summary

minimal_validation_unit.pattern_role: evidence organization / reuse layer (not validation target)

governance_boundary_check.authority_ladder: Observation -> Evidence -> Structural -> Semantic Candidate -> Human Validation (Semantic Claim) -> Validated Pattern -> Capability Candidate -> Human Declaration -> Human Registration -> Capability

eight_questions.Q1_pattern_reduces_cognitive_load: Not automatically. Naive Pattern B may INCREASE per-validation load (exposure 30-60>21). Only Workflow C + System compression + Progressive Disclosure reduces by design, UNVERIFIED [H]
eight_questions.Q2_naive_pattern_abstraction_burden: YES. Human owns 8/10 abstraction tasks. Violates 'validate not reconstruct'
eight_questions.Q3_minimal_semantic_more_reasonable: YES (design level). System owns abstraction; Human owns semantic judgment; lowest default exposure. Depends on unimplemented capability + unverified mitigation
eight_questions.Q4_representative_boundary_negative_unkn: YES. System evidence support objects, not Human mandatory checklist. Evidence visibility != Evidence authority
eight_questions.Q5_progressive_disclosure_reduces_defaul: YES (design). Default Level 0 minimal. Risk=hidden evidence; mitigation=honest summary+accessible provenance+on-demand audit. Residual risk=silent suppression
eight_questions.Q6_minimal_validation_unit: Semantic Claim (not Instance, not Pattern). Pattern=evidence organization/reuse layer

Q7_measurable_human_validation_cost.future_experiment: A/B/C workflow x human subjects, fit HVC

eight_questions.Q8_pattern_worth_continuing: KEEP + REDESIGN. Model 1 rejected (burden transfer); Model 2 retained (pattern=evidence-org layer, validation unit=Semantic Claim, System abstraction, Progressive Disclosure). Not default-KEEP due to prior acceptance — this review negated Model 1

core_principle_final_judgment.statement: DICE Pattern success criterion is NOT 'fewer cases seen by Human' but 'Human gets sufficient Evidence in fewer/simpler/clearer semantic judgments, without abstraction work transferred to Human'
core_principle_final_judgment.supplement: 'sufficient Evidence' = honest summary + on-demand expandable + auditable provenance (not 'show all by default'); abstraction (commonality/boundary/negative/UNKNOWN/scope/provenance) by System; Human only semantic interpretation + final authorization

new_observation_measurement_request: NONE (existing frozen Observation sufficient for pattern prerequisites; gap=aggregation/compression layer, not measurement)

gate.HUMAN_ABSTRACTION_BURDEN: IDENTIFIED in B (8/10 on Human); ELIMINATED by design in C (requires System capability)
gate.PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE: DESIGN PROPOSED (Level 0-4); reduces default load; residual risk=silent suppression
gate.TOTAL_HUMAN_COST_MODEL: HVC defined (8 vars, no fake weights)
gate.LONG_TERM_SUSTAINABILITY: C only potentially sustainable @10000 (H, unverified); A/B unsustainable @1000+
